title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Overview
body:
Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database is a capability database for evidence-weighted synthesis. Evidence-weighted synthesis combines several pieces of evidence into one answer, giving stronger and more reliable evidence more weight than weak or uncertain evidence.

The capability rests on evidence weights, weighted combination, uncertainty reporting, source tracing. Each of these ideas is explained in plain sentences in the records that follow, so a reader can understand what the capability does before studying how it would be built.

This database holds ten full records: an overview, a core design, an architecture, a working demo with its analysis, an implementation status, tests and validation, related capabilities, limits and safeguards, and a roadmap. title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Core Design
body:
The core design of evidence-weighted synthesis starts from one plain rule: Evidence-weighted synthesis combines several pieces of evidence into one answer, giving stronger and more reliable evidence more weight than weak or uncertain evidence.

The design is organised around evidence weights, weighted combination, uncertainty reporting, source tracing. Inputs enter through a stated entry point, are checked against stated rules, and leave as a checked result with a record of what happened, so any later reader can retrace the decision.

Nothing in the core design depends on hidden behaviour. title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Architecture
body:
The architecture of evidence-weighted synthesis has three layers. The first layer accepts work and checks that it is well formed. The second layer applies the capability logic, using evidence weights, weighted combination, uncertainty reporting, source tracing. The third layer records results, reports failures, and exposes the outcome for review.

Each layer can be tested on its own, and each layer keeps its own log, so a fault in one layer does not silently corrupt the others. State is kept explicit, with no step relying on a value that was never written down.

Scaling is handled by the same rules at any size: the same checks, the same limits, and the same reporting apply whether the workload is ten items or ten thousand, and the architecture states where it would need more capacity before it is asked to carry more. Evidence-weighted synthesis combines several pieces of evidence into one answer, giving stronger and more reliable evidence more weight than weak or uncertain evidence. The program below is small on purpose: it shows the core decision in code that a reader can run, read, and change.

The demo was executed at build time, and the output stored with this record is the real captured output of that run, not a hand-written expectation. Running the same code again produces the same output, because the demo uses fixed inputs and no randomness.

title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Demo Analysis
body:
The demo for evidence-weighted synthesis proves that the core decision can be expressed as clear code with observable output: inputs go in, the stated rule is applied, and a checkable result comes out.

What the demo does not prove is equally important. It does not prove performance at network scale, it does not prove behaviour under real production load or failure, and it does not prove that any live system in the network already uses this capability. Those claims would need separate evidence, and none is claimed here.

Read the demo as a logic check and a teaching tool: a correct miniature of the idea, honestly bounded. This Signature edition is an original Signature design, labeled as such, and is not presented as an established public fact.

title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Tests and Validation
body:
Tests for evidence-weighted synthesis start with the demo itself: fixed inputs, deterministic output, and a stored output that later runs must match exactly. Any change to the logic that changes the output must be explained, not hidden.

Further tests check the edges: empty input, a single item, an item at exactly the stated limit, and an item just beyond it. Each edge case has an expected outcome written before the test runs, and a test that fails stops the release of that change until the failure is understood.

Validation also checks the records themselves: every record is full prose, every identifier is unique, every demo output matches a fresh run, and no record claims a deployment that has not happened.

title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Limits, Risks and Safeguards
body:
The limits of evidence-weighted synthesis are stated, not discovered by accident. The design works within stated sizes, stated budgets, and stated time bounds, and it refuses or reports rather than silently degrading when those bounds are reached.

Risks include misconfiguration, stale state, and over-trust in a demo that is only a miniature. Safeguards against those risks are explicit: stated limits, checked outputs, audit records of decisions, human review where risk is high, and a stop rule that halts work rather than letting a fault spread.

This database is defensive and design-only in its security aspects: it describes detection, checking, ordering, and resistance to faults, and it contains no instructions for attacking, defeating, or undermining any system.

title: Evidence-Weighted Synthesis Database: Roadmap to Full Implementation
body:
The roadmap from designed to deployed for evidence-weighted synthesis proceeds in stages. First, the design and demo in this database are reviewed for correctness and clarity. Second, a small staged trial runs the logic on real but bounded work, with measured results kept as evidence.

Third, the trial results decide whether to widen the trial, revise the design, or stop. Widening happens only on positive measured evidence, and each widening keeps the same checks, limits, and reporting that the trial used.

Full implementation is declared only when staged evidence supports it, at which point the status record would be updated by a new, evidenced record. Until then, the honest status remains designed, and this database continues to say so plainly.
